stem_book: A molecule with the formula AX₄Y has all its elements from p-block. Element A is rarest, monoatomic, non-radioactive from its group and has the lowest ionization enthalpy value among A, X and Y. Elements X and Y have first and second highest electronegativity values respectively among all the known elements. The shape of the molecule is (a) pentagonal planar (b) octahedral (c) square pyramidal (d) trigonal bipyramidal
work: A = Xe, X = F, Y = O → XeOF₄: 5 bp + 1 lp, sp³d² → square pyramidal
